_comment: The English narration of the concessions film, one entry per segment
of jadwalKonsesiEN.json's urutan. tts_konsesi.py --bahasa en generates
each clip from here; the mp3s are gitignored.
Same figures as narasiKonsesi.json, all from src/konsesiData.json.
Acronyms are written as hyphenated capitals (P-T-A-M) so the voice
reads letters; 'P.T. A.M.' would risk 'a.m.' being read as morning.

teks.01-pertanyaan: Kalimantan is burning again this year. And the question that always follows is: how much of it burned inside oil palm concessions?
teks.02-peta: From January to August twenty twenty-six, NASA's MODIS satellites mapped about two hundred and ninety-two thousand hectares of burned land across Kalimantan.
teks.03-seperlima: Oil palm concessions cover almost a fifth of Kalimantan's land. Nineteen point six percent. If fire paid no attention to concession boundaries, roughly a fifth of the burn scars would fall inside them.
teks.04-tiga-tahun: In twenty nineteen and twenty twenty-three, that is exactly what happened. About nineteen percent. This year, twenty-three point six percent. Higher, but not by much.
teks.05-ketapang: The excess gathers in one place: the coast of Ketapang, in West Kalimantan. Just four concessions, P-T-A-M, P-T-S-K-M, P-T-M-K-K, and P-T-S-P-A-S, account for almost twenty-six thousand hectares.
teks.06-sepertiga: In two of them, more than a third of the concession burned in a single season. In the third, almost a third.
teks.07-di-luar: But three quarters of the burned area lies outside concessions. This year's largest fire, almost fifteen thousand hectares in Kotawaringin Timur, was only one tenth inside a concession.
teks.08-september: Burned-area data only runs to August. Since September, satellites have logged almost two hundred thousand fire hotspot detections in Kalimantan. Twenty-two percent of them inside concessions. The same pattern.
teks.09-tutup: Location is not proof. These boundaries come from Ministry of Forestry data from around twenty twelve, and fire crosses boundaries. What this map shows is where the checking should begin.
